faqs.question: Can you deliver keynote highlights while our conference is still underway?
faqs.answer: Yes. For summits with immediate press or social requirements, we offer dedicated fast-turnaround workflows, delivering polished keynote soundbites and vertical LinkedIn cutdowns within 24 to 48 hours while event momentum is highest.

faqs.question: Can you capture stage presentations and executive interviews simultaneously?
faqs.answer: Yes. We configure modular camera setups tailored to your programme. While main cameras capture the stage keynote and direct presentation slides, a dedicated unit can record 1-on-1 executive interviews in a quiet breakout room.

faqs.question: How do you coordinate with our event production team and venue schedule?
faqs.answer: We liaise directly with your event organisers and venue AV teams in advance to confirm technical inputs, stage audio feeds, and schedules, ensuring filming runs smoothly alongside your live agenda without obstructing delegates.
